episode_summary: In this episode, Brenton Miebach shares how he successfully entered new real estate markets using AI-driven systems and paid leads. He discusses the power of AI in replacing traditional roles and how engaging historical content can rapidly grow social media presence. Brenton's insights offer actionable strategies for REALTORS looking to leverage technology for growth.
